# json-schema-subset

## Functions

### jsonSchemaSubset()

```ts
function jsonSchemaSubset(
  allowNullable?,
): ZodPipe<
  ZodUnknown,
  ZodType<
    boolean | Record<string, JSONType>,
    unknown,
    $ZodTypeInternals<boolean | Record<string, JSONType>, unknown>
  >
>;
```

Decode the supported schema subset before using the shared Zod compiler. Refuse
depth over 32, more than 50,000 expanded nodes and reserved keys before
recursive decoding. Callers bound transport bytes separately.
